identifier.reasoning: This column lists the variable names or traits being defined in the regression analysis.

Multiple regression Estimate.reasoning: This column holds the calculated regression coefficient (estimate) for each variable.

Multiple regression SE.reasoning: This column provides the standard error (SE) associated with the regression estimate.

Multiple regression z.reasoning: This column holds the calculated z-score for the regression estimate.

Multiple regression p.reasoning: This column provides the p-value for the multiple regression model.

Multiple regression Models.reasoning: This column describes the structure of the regression model used (e.g., number of variables).

Individual regression $R^2$.reasoning: This column holds the coefficient of determination ($R^2$) for the individual regression.

Individual regression p.reasoning: This column provides the p-value for the individual regression analysis.
